summaries.summary: In summer 2026 volunteers surveyed all 4 sites in the Derwent catchment. Phosphate was in the "slightly elevated" band at every site, from 0.13 mg/l on Thornton Beck to 0.22 mg/l on the River Derwent. E. coli was at or above the 10 cfu threshold at all four sites, from 12 cfu on the River Derwent to 47 cfu on Thornton Beck. Volunteers noted things such as livestock and built-up areas near some sites.
summaries.model: claude-sonnet-5-5 (drafted in a Claude Code session)

metals.summary: Lab tests at all 4 Derwent sites measured 24 metals. Everyday minerals such as calcium, magnesium, sodium and potassium were found at every site, along with iron, aluminium and manganese. Cadmium, chromium and lead were not detected at any site, and copper was detected at just one. The highest iron and aluminium results were at DC04 on the River Derwent. Thresholds for these metals have not yet been established, so it is not yet possible to say whether a result is good or bad.
metals.model: claude-sonnet-5-5 (drafted in a Claude Code session)

summaries.summary: In summer 2026 volunteers surveyed all 20 sites in the Foss catchment. Phosphate was the main concern: 13 of the 19 readings were in the "very high" band, the typical (median) reading was 1.35 mg/l, and the highest was 2.5 mg/l on South Beck. Only the River Foss site FC01, at 0.1 mg/l, was in the "low" band. E. coli looked better, with 16 of 20 sites under the 10 cfu threshold, though four were at or above it, up to 56 cfu on Howl Beck. Volunteers noted duckweed, litter and urban drainage near some sites.
summaries.model: claude-sonnet-5-5 (drafted in a Claude Code session)

metals.summary: Lab tests at all 20 Foss sites measured 24 metals. Everyday minerals such as calcium, magnesium, sodium and potassium were found at every site, as were iron, aluminium, manganese, nickel and zinc. Copper was detected at 19 sites and chromium at 15, while cadmium was not detected anywhere and lead at only one site (FC19, on the Foss). The highest iron, aluminium, copper and zinc results were at FC02 on the Foss, and the highest manganese and nickel results at FC08 on Black Dike. Thresholds for these metals have not yet been established, so it is not yet possible to say whether a result is good or bad.

summaries.summary: In summer 2026 volunteers surveyed 7 of the 9 sites in the Gledhow Lake catchment, and the results were mixed. Phosphate ranged from 0.05 mg/l to 2.11 mg/l, both on Gledhow Beck, with a median of 0.43 mg/l and two sites in the "very high" band. For E. coli, three sites were under the 10 cfu threshold and four were at or above it, the highest being 128 cfu. Volunteers noted urban and residential drainage near some sites.

Volunteers noted a range of possible sources of pollution near some sites.
